tools.name: get_funding_application
tools.description: Clearwater Capital Group business funding application for US small business owners (merchant cash advances, lines of credit, term loans; $10K-$2M; no hard credit pull to apply). Returns the rules for agents and every field to ask the owner. Call this first.

tools.name: create_review_link

Stores nothing and sends nothing. Get the owner's OK on their answers first. Never include a Social Security number,
